SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ t.F_TRADE_ID outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_ID secId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR secAbbr,/**资产简称**/ t.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, case when t.PS != 'T07' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F23' THEN '01' when t.PS != 'T07' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F24' THEN '02' ELSE '03' END AS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ stl.SETTLE_DATE settdateDate,/**交割日期**/ t.VDATE vdate,/**起息日**/ t.MDATE mdate,/**到期日**/ t.MDATE-t.VDATE term, t.PRIN_AMT/10000 prinAmt, t.YIELD*100 feeRate,/**借贷费率%**/ case when t.PS != 'T07' then t.PRIN_AMT*t.YIELD*(t.MDATE-t.VDATE)/365 else t.TRADE_AMT end as fee, t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ nvl(t.MY_ACCT_NO,stl.MY_ACCT_NO) acctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='14' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd ON ttfd.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID and ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B08' where t.BUSI_TYPE ='14'
and t.TRADE_ID like concat(concat('%',#{tradeId}),'%')
and deal.BOOKSET_ID IN
#{finprodId}
and t.TRADE_DATE >= to_date(#{tradeDateBegin},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.TRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{tradeDateEnd},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and t.FINPROD_TYPE in(#{FINPROD_TYPE_F23},#{FINPROD_TYPE_F24})
and t.FINPROD_TYPE in(#{FINPROD_TYPE_F23}) and t.PS != 'T07'
and t.FINPROD_TYPE in(#{FINPROD_TYPE_F24}) and t.PS != 'T07'
and t.FINPROD_TYPE in(#{FINPROD_TYPE_F23},#{FINPROD_TYPE_F24}) and t.PS = 'T07'
and t.FINPROD_TYPE in(#{FINPROD_TYPE_F23},#{FINPROD_TYPE_F24}) and t.PS != 'T07'
and t.FINPROD_TYPE in(#{FINPROD_TYPE_F23}) or(t.FINPROD_TYPE in(#{FINPROD_TYPE_F23},#{FINPROD_TYPE_F24}) and t.PS = 'T07')
and t.FINPROD_TYPE in(#{FINPROD_TYPE_F24}) or(t.FINPROD_TYPE in(#{FINPROD_TYPE_F23},#{FINPROD_TYPE_F24}) and t.PS = 'T07')
order by t.TRADE_ID desc

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ t.F_TRADE_ID outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ t.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, zc.FINPROD_ID secId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR secAbbr,/**资产简称**/ case when t.PS != 'T07' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F23' THEN '01' when t.PS != 'T07' and t.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F24' THEN '02' ELSE '03' END AS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ stl.SETTLE_DATE settdateDate,/**交割日期**/ t.VDATE vdate,/**起息日**/ t.MDATE mdate,/**到期日**/ t.MDATE-t.VDATE term,/**期限**/ t.PRIN_AMT/10000 prinAmt,/**券面总额**/ t.YIELD*100 feeRate,/**借贷费率%**/ t.PRIN_AMT*t.YIELD*(t.MDATE-t.VDATE)/365 fee,/**借贷费**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ ttfd.FEE_AMT stlFeeAmt,/**结算手续费**/ nvl(t.MY_ACCT_NO,stl.MY_ACCT_NO) acctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='14' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd ON ttfd.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID and ttfd.FEE_TYPE = 'B08' where t.BUSI_TYPE ='14' and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} order by t.TRADE_ID desc

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ t.F_TRADE_ID outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ deal.BOOKSET_ID prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_ID secId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR secAbbr,/**资产简称**/ t.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, '03' ps,/**交易方向**/ t.MDATE tradeDate,/**交易日**/ t.VDATE vdate,/**起息日**/ t.MDATE mdate,/**到期日**/ t.MDATE-t.VDATE term,/**期限**/ t.PRIN_AMT/10000 prinAmt,/**券面总额**/ t.YIELD*100 feeRate,/**借贷费率%**/ t.PRIN_AMT*t.YIELD*(t.MDATE-t.VDATE)/365 fee,/**借贷费**/ t.TRADE_AMT settleAmt, t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ nvl(t.MY_ACCT_NO,stl.MY_ACCT_NO) acctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE ='14' LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL ttfd ON ttfd.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID where t.BUSI_TYPE ='14' and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} order by t.TRADE_ID desc
